svg.title: Kudarat: dated leadership and an agreement
svg.desc: Modern timeline based on the NHCP marker: Kudarat ruled Maguindanao from 1619 to 1671. A peace agreement is identified in 1645. This is not an exact territorial map or a transcript of negotiations.

g.text: Modern teaching timeline / Based on the NHCP marker
Leadership could include alliances and negotiation
as well as opposition to colonial forces.
A later marker does not supply every conversation or local response.
